tailoring.headline: Business Analyst Global E-Commerce Technology | SAP Certified & E-Commerce Developer
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Business Analyst and SAP Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering global e-commerce platforms, B2B/B2C solutions, and digital integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in requirements engineering, business process modelling, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT coordination across international teams. Extensive hands-on background in REST APIs, order management, data pipelines, and agile delivery using Jira and Confluence, combined with practical expertise in generative AI tools for analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Business Analyst Global E-Commerce Technology
cover_en.hook: PUMA's commitment to speed, spirit, and driving high-performance global digital platforms makes this Business Analyst role an ideal match for my background. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution across complex digital ecosystems.

bullets.label: Requirements Engineering & Process Design
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders at Rockwell Automation, analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: UAT & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) across agile release cycles at Shell.

bullets.label: Generative AI for Analysis & Documentation
bullets.text: Used AI tools and generative AI / LLMs extensively to accelerate analysis, requirements structuring, development, testing, and technical documentation.

bullets.label: Global E-Commerce & Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Coordinated with international technical teams and business stakeholders to design and optimize data pipelines, order management workflows, and REST-based digital platform integrations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional expertise can support PUMA's global e-commerce technology team.

tailoring.why_company: PUMA's dedication to speed and spirit combined with its powerful global e-commerce presence presents an exciting environment for a techno-functional Business Analyst. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience bridging business needs and technical delivery to help optimize PUMA's digital platforms, streamline requirements workflows, and drive collaborative agile execution.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my techno-functional e-commerce background and experience in requirements engineering, stakeholder management, and generative AI to support PUMA's global technology delivery.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a techno-functional Business Analyst and SAP Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience in requirements engineering, process mapping, and agile global e-commerce delivery. I applied for the Business Analyst Global E-Commerce Technology role and would love to connect!
tailoring.offer: In my first months, I will bring immediate value to PUMA by streamlining requirements engineering workflows, optimizing end-to-end business process documentation, and facilitating seamless collaboration between business, product, and engineering teams. Leveraging my deep background in global e-commerce platforms and generative AI tools, I will ensure high-quality user stories, robust UAT standards, and efficient agile delivery.
tailoring.insight: PUMA's focus on global eCommerce platforms, CMS, Search, CRM, and integrated digital systems requires meticulous alignment between business processes and technical architecture. My proven experience bridging business requirements with backend integrations and order management across international enterprise projects positions me to immediately support your digital commerce roadmap.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Business Analyst Global E-Commerce Technology (Kranti Chavan)
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

As a techno-functional Business Analyst and E-Commerce Developer with over 5 years of enterprise experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am thrilled to apply for the Business Analyst Global E-Commerce Technology role at PUMA. I specialize in requirements engineering, business process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT coordination across international digital platforms.

PUMA's dynamic global e-commerce ecosystem is an ideal fit for my background in aligning business stakeholders with engineering teams and leveraging generative AI for process documentation. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
